about: Judges tells how God's people kept forgetting Him, and how God sent leaders called judges to save them.

pages.title: Deborah Leads the Way
pages.scene: Deborah sitting under her palm tree
pages.text: Deborah was a wise judge. She sat under a palm tree and helped people. God told her that it was time to free His people from a cruel army. She went with the leader Barak, and God won the battle. Deborah sang a happy song to God.
pages.lesson: God uses anyone who trusts Him.

pages.title: Gideon's Small Army
pages.scene: Gideon's men with horns, jars and torches
pages.text: Gideon was hiding when an angel said, "God is with you, brave man!" God made Gideon's army very small, just three hundred men. At night they blew horns, broke jars and held up torches. The enemy ran away! Everyone knew God had won.
pages.lesson: God is strong, even when we feel small.

pages.title: Strong Samson
pages.text: God made Samson very strong. He even fought a lion with his bare hands! But Samson did not always obey God. He lost his strength and was caught. At the end, he prayed, and God gave him strength one last time.
pages.lesson: Use the gifts God gives you to obey Him.
